senses.zh: （活动、工作、知识等的）范围，领域
senses.en: a particular area of activity, work, knowledge, etc.
examples: Women have been taking more important positions of power in the public [[sphere]].

senses.en: the best or most important
examples: He is one of the country's [[foremost]] authorities on criminal law.

senses.en: a book in which sb. writes about their own life
examples: He gives a vivid description of his childhood in his [[autobiography]].

senses.zh: 重要的；著名的；卓越的；杰出的
senses.en: important
examples: He played a [[prominent]] role in promoting public health awareness in developing countries.

senses.en: make a good combination with sb. / sth. else
examples: For the show, the museum is borrowing 20 paintings that [[complement]] its own collection.

senses.en: complementary things go well together, although they are usually different
examples: The computer and the human mind have different but [[complementary]] abilities.

senses.zh: 最前线；最前列；最重要的位置
senses.en: (the ~) a leading or important position
examples: The company has always been at the [[forefront]] of science and technology.

senses.en: writing which expresses judgments about the good or bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.
examples: Art [[criticism]] is about how we evaluate and interpret art.
My main [[criticism]] of the scheme is that it does nothing to help families on low incomes.

senses.en: remarks that say what you think is bad about sb. / sth.
examples: Art [[criticism]] is about how we evaluate and interpret art.
My main [[criticism]] of the scheme is that it does nothing to help families on low incomes.

senses.zh: （代表某一特定地方或历史时期的）服装，装束
senses.en: clothes that are typical of a particular place or period of time in the past
examples: The dancers were in national [[costume]] to celebrate the National Day.
Maybe you should take off that wolf [[costume]] and show him how it's done.

senses.en: a set of clothes worn by an actor or by sb. to make them look like sth., such as an animal or a famous person.
examples: The dancers were in national [[costume]] to celebrate the National Day.
Maybe you should take off that wolf [[costume]] and show him how it's done.

senses.zh: （尤指能代表某种观点或某一时代）非常出名的，受欢迎的
senses.en: very famous or popular, esp. being considered to represent particular opinions or a particular time
examples: The Phantom of the Opera must be the most [[iconic]] Broadway musical ever, and it's for a good reason — it's so incredible.

senses.en: a work of art, a piece of writing or music, etc. that is of very high quality or that is the best that a particular artist, writer, etc. has produced
examples: Mary Shelley was just 21 when she published her [[masterpiece]] Frankenstein.

senses.en: (fml.) move sb. / sth. to a more important level or rank, or make them better than before
examples: A well-chosen handbag can really [[elevate]] a woman's level of fashion.

senses.en: (fml.) the quality of being useful, or the degree to which sth. is useful
examples: I have severe doubts about the [[utility]] of examinations on subjects learned this way.
Officials said water supplies and other public [[utilities]] in the capital were badly affected.

senses.zh: 公用事业（如煤气、电力等）
senses.en: a service such as gas or electricity provided for people to use
examples: I have severe doubts about the [[utility]] of examinations on subjects learned this way.
Officials said water supplies and other public [[utilities]] in the capital were badly affected.

senses.en: the quality of relating to or limited by time
examples: He argues that [[temporality]] cannot be identified with ordinary clock time.

senses.en: limit sth.
examples: Poor soil has [[constrained]] the level of crop production in this area.
Financial factors should not [[constrain]] doctors from prescribing the best treatment for patients.

senses.en: stop sb. from doing what they want to do
examples: Poor soil has [[constrained]] the level of crop production in this area.
Financial factors should not [[constrain]] doctors from prescribing the best treatment for patients.

senses.en: the shape of the outer edges of sth. such as an area of land or sb.'s body
examples: Maybe you can try this seat — it can be adjusted to fit the [[contours]] of your back.

senses.en: the way you think about sth. and your idea of what it is like
examples: There is a general public [[perception]] that social media can be addictive.

senses.zh: （音乐、文学作品等）前卫的，先锋派的
senses.en: avant-garde music, literature, etc. is extremely modern and often seems strange or slightly shocking
examples: His paintings are rather too [[avant-garde]] for my taste.

senses.en: sharply defined; easy to understand
examples: While there are a number of arguments in favor of school uniforms, the issue of whether or not they should be required is not a [[clear-cut]] matter.

senses.en: become or make sth. become difficult to distinguish clearly
examples: The design of this museum is meant to [[blur]] the distinction between the house and the garden.
The words [[blurred]] and danced before his eyes.

senses.en: become difficult to see, or make sth. difficult to see, because the edges are not clear
examples: The design of this museum is meant to [[blur]] the distinction between the house and the garden.
The words [[blurred]] and danced before his eyes.

senses.en: oppose or fight against sb. in authority or against an idea or situation which you do not agree with
examples: A vast majority of the voters [[rebelled]] against the high property taxes.

senses.zh: （画家、演员、电影制作人等作品的）回顾展
senses.en: a show of the work of an artist, actor, film-maker, etc. that includes examples of all the kinds of work they have done
examples: We timed the release of the film to coincide with a big [[retrospective]] of Bosch's paintings at Rotterdam.

senses.zh: 蒙昧的；未开化的；野蛮的
senses.en: (only before noun) an offensive way of referring to groups of people or customs that are considered to be simple and not highly developed
examples: The novel is about a [[savage]] tribe with alien customs and ceremonies.
They caught the monkey, but it was so [[savage]] that no one could get near enough to feed it.

senses.en: very violent or cruel
examples: The novel is about a [[savage]] tribe with alien customs and ceremonies.
They caught the monkey, but it was so [[savage]] that no one could get near enough to feed it.

senses.en: a public meeting where land, buildings, paintings, etc. are sold to the person who offers the most money for them
examples: If he did not come back in time, his whole property would be sold by [[auction]].

senses.zh: 旧式的，老式的（但品质优良）
senses.en: old, but of high quality
examples: It looks like a [[vintage]] cell phone of the last century and weighs about 13 ounces.
They served lobster, accompanied by a bottle of [[vintage]] champagne.

senses.zh: （某特定年份酿制的葡萄酒）佳酿的，上等的，优质的
senses.en: vintage wine is good quality wine made in a particular year
examples: It looks like a [[vintage]] cell phone of the last century and weighs about 13 ounces.
They served lobster, accompanied by a bottle of [[vintage]] champagne.

senses.zh: 昂贵时装的设计制作；昂贵时装
senses.en: (also haute-couture) the design and production of expensive and fashionable clothes, or the clothes themselves
examples: Around 25 designers will show their [[couture]] collections during the international fashion week.

senses.zh: 社会 / 法律 / 政治等的框架
senses.en: (social / legal / political, etc. framework) the structure of a society, a legal or political system, etc.
examples: There is no escaping the fact that we have to act within the existing legal [[framework]].
This paper provides a useful conceptual [[framework]] for future research.

senses.en: a set of ideas, rules, or beliefs from which sth. is developed, or on which decisions are based
examples: There is no escaping the fact that we have to act within the existing legal [[framework]].
This paper provides a useful conceptual [[framework]] for future research.

senses.zh: 不可避免的；不容忽视的
senses.en: an inescapable fact or situation is one that you cannot avoid or ignore
examples: She didn't want to confront the [[inescapable]] fact that she would have to sell the house.

senses.en: sth. that limits your freedom to do what you want
examples: [[Constraints]] on spending have forced the company to rethink its plans.

senses.en: an unplanned additional result of sth. that you do
examples: The deep depression he fell into was a [[byproduct]] of his disease.
Sugar and its [[byproducts]] are the basis of the island's economy.

senses.en: sth. additional that is produced during a natural or industrial process
examples: The deep depression he fell into was a [[byproduct]] of his disease.
Sugar and its [[byproducts]] are the basis of the island's economy.

senses.en: connected with beauty and the study of beauty
examples: From an [[aesthetic]] point of view, this piece of furniture is a nice design.

senses.en: a product that is bought and sold
examples: [[Commodity]] prices can be a useful indicator of inflation, he claimed.

senses.zh: 借助已有的···实现新（或更好）的目标
senses.en: use sth. that you already have in order to achieve sth. new or better
examples: We can gain a market advantage by [[leveraging]] our network of partners.

senses.zh: （尤指在科学或艺术方面）合作，协作
senses.en: work together with a person or group in order to achieve sth., esp. in science or art
examples: Educators and employers need to [[collaborate]] in preparing the next generation for employment.

senses.zh: （尤指在科学或艺术方面的）合作，协作
senses.en: when you work together with another person or group to achieve sth., esp. in science or art
examples: The company is building the center in [[collaboration]] with an engineering institute.

senses.en: (fml.) a very large amount of sth.
examples: It is a delightful river with a [[profusion]] of wild flowers along its banks.

senses.en: sth. that is nonexistent does not exist at all, or is not present in a particular place
examples: Her friends never missed a chance to tease her about her [[nonexistent]] relationship with Brandon.

senses.zh: （人、组织或生物）互相依赖的，共生的
senses.en: (fml.) a symbiotic relationship is one in which the people, organizations, or living things involved depend on each other
examples: Do some viruses develop a [[symbiotic]] relationship with their host?

senses.en: an exchange, esp. of ideas or thoughts
examples: What made the meeting exciting was the [[interchange]] of ideas from different disciplines.

senses.en: (fml.) (only before noun) according to what is correct or what should be done legally or morally
examples: George sat at the head of the table, in his [[rightful]] place as their leader.

senses.zh: 复杂的；详尽的；精心制作的
senses.en: very complicated and detailed; carefully prepared and organized
examples: You need a plain blouse to go with that skirt — nothing too [[elaborate]].

senses.en: (fml.) dealing with ideas, or based on them
examples: Some of us learn experientially, while others are more attracted to logical or [[conceptual]] learning.

senses.en: relating to your spirit rather than to your body or mind
examples: While improving material well-being, we should also enrich our [[spiritual]] life.

senses.zh: 首先，首要的是（用于强调）
senses.en: used to emphasize the most important quality, purpose, reason, etc.
examples: What children need first and [[foremost]] from their parents is a sense of security.

senses.zh: 艾尔莎 • 夏帕瑞丽（意大利时装设计师）
伊夫 • 圣 • 罗兰（法国时装设计师）
巴勃罗 • 毕加索（西班牙画家、雕塑家）
senses.en: (Pablo Picasso)

senses.zh: 克劳德 • 莫奈（法国印象派画家）
senses.en: (Claude Monet)

senses.zh: 克莱尔 • 麦克安德鲁（爱尔兰艺术经济学家）
卡尔 • 拉格斐（德国时装设计师）
安迪 • 沃霍尔（美国波普艺术家和电影制片人）
